    • multiplier

      public BackoffPolicy.Builder multiplier(double multiplier)
      Multiplier applied to the previous delay on each retry. Must be >= 1.0. Default is 2.0 (exponential backoff). Use 1.0 for fixed backoff.
      Parameters:
      multiplier - the per-attempt multiplier
      Returns:
      this builder

    • jitterPercent

      public BackoffPolicy.Builder jitterPercent(double jitterPercent)
      Symmetric jitter percentage applied to each returned delay. The actual jitter is the base delay multiplied by a uniform random factor in [1 - jitterPercent/200, 1 + jitterPercent/200). Default is 10.0; set to 0 to disable jitter.
      Parameters:
      jitterPercent - the jitter percentage, must be in [0, 100]
      Returns:
      this builder
